Title: Aarav and the Family

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Isha - 8 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Anita and Isha stand near him.]

Aarav: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Anita: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aarav runs to Mother.]

Aarav (softly): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aarav: "One more time!"

[Aarav hides behind the tree.]

Anita: "That's great!"

[Aarav searches for his lost ball.]

Isha: "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Isha stands in the living room. Aarav and Anita stand near her.]

Isha: "What a nice place."

[Isha applies kajal to her eyes.]

Isha (softly): "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aarav (happily): "Careful!"

[Aarav munches on an apple.]

Aarav: "That's great!"

[Aarav gulps down a glass of milk.]

Aarav: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Aarav sits down on a chair.]

Isha (gently): "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Anita and Isha stand near him.]

Isha: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav catches the ball.]

Aarav (softly): "I'm ready!"

[Aarav kicks the football hard.]

Isha: "Yes, all right."

[Aarav plays cricket in the park.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

[Aarav swings on the swing.]

Anita: "Careful!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

Aarav: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav folds his hands and prays.]

Aarav: "Hmm, I see."

[Aarav lights a diya.]

Aarav: "That's great!"

[Isha draws a rangoli at the door.]

Anita: "Show me too!"

[Aarav paints a picture.]

Aarav (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Aarav draws a picture of the house.]

Anita (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
